name: @erasuremesh/openapi-core
description: OpenAPI contracts for Erasuremesh (common + identity + product domains)

scripts.bundle:domains: mkdir -p src/.bundled && redocly bundle identity --output src/.bundled/identity.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle identity --output src/.bundled/identity.json && redocly bundle processor-graph --output src/.bundled/processor-graph.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle processor-graph --output src/.bundled/processor-graph.json && redocly bundle erasure-orders --output src/.bundled/erasure-orders.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle erasure-orders --output src/.bundled/erasure-orders.json && redocly bundle derived-artefacts --output src/.bundled/derived-artefacts.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle derived-artefacts --output src/.bundled/derived-artefacts.json && redocly bundle recipient-notices --output src/.bundled/recipient-notices.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle recipient-notices --output src/.bundled/recipient-notices.json && redocly bundle evidence-packs --output src/.bundled/evidence-packs.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle evidence-packs --output src/.bundled/evidence-packs.json && redocly bundle exceptions --output src/.bundled/exceptions.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle exceptions --output src/.bundled/exceptions.json
